evidence.title: GitHub - aniftyco/awesome-tailwindcss: 😎 Awesome things related to Tailwind CSS · GitHub

name: Awesome Tailwind CSS
summary: Curated list of Tailwind CSS resources: official links, IDE extensions, tools, UI libraries and templates, and plugins.
description: A curated repository of resources for Tailwind CSS, grouped into useful links, IDE extensions, tools, UI libraries/components & templates, and plugins. Entries carry emoji legends marking official resources, online tools, browser extensions, generators, color tools, frameworks and deprecated items. 15.2k stars, 543 commits, CC0-1.0 licensed, and open to contributions.
contains: curated list of Tailwind CSS resources; contributions welcome
sections: useful links, IDE extensions, tools, UI libraries/components & templates, plugins
22 tools incl. color palette generators, converters, config viewer and browser extensions
26 UI libraries, component kits and templates (shadcn UI, daisyUI, Flowbite, HyperUI, Tremor …)
12 plugins: typography, forms, themer, fluid, scrollbar-hide and more
legend marks official resources, online tools, generators, color tools, frameworks, deprecated items
